nodes.title: SG-4.4 · Apply device pixel ratio at runtime
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/config.ts exports computeZoom(w,h,dpr) but nothing calls it. buildGameConfig sets no zoom, and PhaserHost's ResizeObserver only calls scale.refresh(). Desired behavior: the zoom computed from window.devicePixelRatio and the container size is passed into the game config at creation, and recomputed in the ResizeObserver callback and when the ratio changes. Expected result: Phaser-mocked unit tests show the zoom is passed in and refreshed on resize. Why: the pixel-art scene stays crisp on high-DPI and resized displays.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a container of 1280x720 and dpr 2, when PhaserHost mounts, then createGame receives zoom equal to computeZoom(1280,720,2)
- Given a mounted PhaserHost, when the ResizeObserver callback fires with a new size or dpr, then scale.setZoom is called with the recomputed zoom and scale.refresh is called
- Given a devicePixelRatio change, when the media query change event fires, then the zoom is recomputed and applied


## Scope
- In scope: buildGameConfig and createGame zoom parameter
- In scope: PhaserHost zoom computation and refresh
- Out of scope: Changing GAME_WIDTH/GAME_HEIGHT
- Out of scope: Changing the computeZoom formula
- Out of scope: Scene or asset changes
- Preserve: Single game instance and destroy(true) cleanup on unmount
- Preserve: pixelArt, roundPixels and FIT scale settings


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only (ScaleManager.setZoom, scale.refresh)
- Unit tests mock createGame and Phaser, no real browser


## Definition of done
- Both requirements verified by passing unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Game config accepts and applies a zoom computed with computeZoom
nodes.body:
Context: buildGameConfig(parent, scenes) in game/frontend/src/phaser/config.ts builds the config without zoom, and createGame forwards only parent and scenes. Desired behavior: an optional zoom argument is forwarded and set as scale.zoom. Expected result: the Phaser game starts with the DPR-derived zoom. Why: initial render uses the correct pixel density.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given zoom 3, when buildGameConfig(parent, scenes, 3) is called, then config.scale.zoom equals 3
- Given no zoom, when buildGameConfig(parent, scenes) is called, then config.scale.zoom equals 1
- Given createGame(parent, scenes, 2), when it runs, then buildGameConfig receives zoom 2


## Scope
- In scope: config.ts buildGameConfig
- In scope: createGame.ts createGame
- Out of scope: PhaserHost
- Preserve: Existing render and scale keys


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 config key scale.zoom


## Definition of done
- Config carries zoom and defaults to 1


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · PhaserHost computes the zoom on mount and refreshes it on resize and ratio change
nodes.body:
Context: PhaserHost.tsx creates the game with createGame(container, scenes) and the ResizeObserver only refreshes. Desired behavior: compute zoom at mount, pass it to createGame, recompute in the ResizeObserver callback and on devicePixelRatio change, and call scale.setZoom then scale.refresh. Expected result: zoom stays correct as the container or ratio changes. Why: crisp pixels at any size.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given container clientWidth 1280, clientHeight 720 and dpr 2, when mounted, then createGame is called with third argument computeZoom(1280,720,2)
- Given the container size changes, when the ResizeObserver callback fires, then scale.setZoom is called with the new zoom before scale.refresh
- Given the dpr changes, when the matchMedia change listener fires, then scale.setZoom is called with the zoom for the new dpr and the listener is removed on unmount


## Scope
- In scope: PhaserHost.tsx
- Out of scope: computeZoom formula
- Preserve: StrictMode single-instance behaviour
- Preserve: destroy(true) on unmount
- Preserve: observer.disconnect on unmount


## Technical constraints
- Guard window.matchMedia when undefined


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Zoom passed at creation and refreshed on resize and ratio change


## Clarifying questions
- None
